description: Install, start and diagnose a minimal local Claude Code bridge under the stock Codex desktop app.

interface.longDescription: Keep the Codex desktop interface and add Claude models through your installed, unmodified Claude Code runtime. Two skills set up or diagnose the small local adapter.
